title: A Surprise Message
text:
Maria sent a text message to her friend Paulo. She wrote, 'Are you free on Friday?' Paulo did not answer for an hour because he was busy at work.

When he finally read the message, he was happy. He wrote back, 'Yes, I am free! Let's go to the cinema.' Maria smiled because she liked the idea.

options: If he was free on Friday
If he wanted a cup of coffee
Yes, I am free! Let's go to the cinema.
No, I am busy on Friday.
Let's meet at the park tomorrow.

questions.text: How did Maria probably feel when Paulo said yes?
What kind of relationship do Maria and Paulo probably have?

not busy, with time to do something else
having a lot of things to do, with no free time

paragraph_translations: Maria enviou uma mensagem de texto para a amiga dela, Paulo. Ela escreveu: 'Você está livre na sexta-feira?' Paulo não respondeu por uma hora, porque estava ocupado no trabalho.
Quando ele finalmente leu a mensagem, ficou feliz. Ele respondeu: 'Sim, estou livre! Vamos ao cinema.' Maria sorriu porque gostou da ideia.
